title: Kokila and Mokoka power JL Bourg to historic first EuroCup title with series sweep of Besiktas
description: Cosea JL Bourg-en-Bresse etched their name into European basketball history on Tuesday night, holding off a furious Besiktas GAIN Istanbul comeback to win 73-71 at Ekinox and complete a 2-0 sweep of the BKT EuroCup Finals â€” claiming the club's first-ever continental trophy and a coveted EuroLeague berth for the 2026-27 season. Kevin Kokila (204-F/C-2001) was immense in the clincher, scoring 18 points on a brutally efficient 6-of-8 from two-point range and 6-of-7 from the free-throw line while grabbing six rebounds â€” four offensive â€” and generating a game-high 27 efficiency in just over 20 minutes. Adam Mokoka (195-G/F-1998), who had been the hero of the Game 1 road victory in Istanbul, backed it up with 17 points on 6-of-12 from inside the arc, adding a game-high 10 rebounds, including four offensive boards, along with an assist and a steal.
